ascend_skill.desc:
The first time Ichigo activates Vorpal Butterfly, gain 1 Chains of Love stack. Also, each time she activates a Highlight, gain 1 Chains of Love stack. Chains of Love stacks up to 3 times.
Gain the following effects based on the number of Chains of Love stacks.
1: For each Lovesick stack inflicted, increase target's damage taken by 4%.
2: Increase critical rate by 15%. Also, all of Ichigo's skill damage is counted as continuous damage.
3: Increase continuous damage by 25%.
ascend_skill.name: Mine Alone

ascend_skill.desc:
For each Lovesick stack inflicted, decrease target's Defense by 3%.
Also, each time a skill is used, inflict 1 more Lovesick stack on the target.
ascend_skill.name: Pounding Heartbeat

ascend_skill.desc:
At the start of battle, gain 1 Chains of Love stack.
Chains of Love now stacks up to 5 times, and gain the following effects based on the number of stacks.
4: Increase critical damage by 36%.
5: The first time Ichigo takes fatal damage, survive with 1 HP and enter a special near-death state, and gain 4 Power of Love stacks. At the end each ally's turn, spend 1 Power of Love stack, and after all Power of Love stacks have been spent, Ichigo will be KO'd.
ascend_skill.name: Power of Love

ascend_skill.desc: Increase the skill levels of My Beloved Prince and Thief Tactics by 3.
ascend_skill.name: Forever My Prince

ascend_skill.desc: Highlight Enhanced: Each time her Highlight is activated, permanently increase Ichigo's Attack by 6%. Stacks up to 5 times.
ascend_skill.name: Maiden's True Strength

ascend_skill.desc: Increase the skill levels of Vorpal Butterfly and Obsessive Rose by 3.
ascend_skill.name: Garden of Devotion

ascend_skill.desc:
Lovesick now stacks up to 15 times.
Based on the total number of Chains of Love stacks, the following effects can be activated. 
1: After activating Vorpal Butterfly, activate Vorpal Butterfly 1 more time on the selected target.
2: After activating Obsessive Rose, activate Obsessive Rose 1 more time on the selected target.
3: After activating My Beloved Prince, activate My Beloved Prince 1 more time on the selected target.
4: During Ichigo's turn, can activate Highlight 1 time on the selected target without spending the Highlight gauge (not affected by Highlight cooldown time).
(Each effect can activate only once during battle. If a target is defeated or the skill is nullified, reflected, or absorbed, a different target is selected for the skill effect.)
ascend_skill.name: A World of Our Own

highlight_skill.desc:
Deal Curse damage to 1 foe equal to 457.1%/503.9%/485.2%/532.0% of Attack, and Lovesick can activate critical hits for 3 turns.
Also, activate all continuous damage effects on the target 1 time, and activate Lovesick effect 2 more times.
highlight_skill.name: Highlight

normal_skill.desc: Deal Curse damage to 1 foe equal to 129.0%/142.2%/137.0%/150.2% of Attack, and inflict 2 Lovesick stacks. When the target has over 70% HP remaining, increase skill damage by 200%. If this skill defeats a target, activate this skill again (can be activated consecutively).
normal_skill.name: Vorpal Butterfly

normal_skill.desc: Deal Curse damage to 1 foe equal to 106.9%/117.8%/113.4%/124.4% of Attack, and inflict 4 Lovesick stacks.
normal_skill.name: Obsessive Rose

normal_skill.desc: Deal Curse damage to 1 foe equal to 254.8%/280.9%/270.4%/296.6% of Attack + 11.7%/12.9%/12.4%/13.6% for each Lovesick stack. Also, when targets have 10 or more Lovesick stacks, deal bonus Curse damage equal to 118.7%/130.9%/126.1%/138.2% of Attack. After activating this skill, reset the duration of Lovesick stacks.
normal_skill.name: My Beloved Prince

passive_skill.desc: For each Chains of Love stack, increase Ichigo's Attack by 15.0%.
passive_skill.name: Overflowing Love

passive_skill.desc: When Ichigo is present, increase party's continuous damage by 15.0%.
passive_skill.name: Melting Ichi-Go Butter
